instruction: open the middle drawer of the cabinet

state.feedback: reset: cameras live, jaws at home (pitch=roll=yaw=0)

note: Agentview: dark cabinet with silver handles is on the right of the frame; stove is on the left; gripper is high above the table center. Wrist: looking down, cabinet at the left edge, jaws not on any object. Action: probe +x by 0.03 m only, to confirm axis sign before approaching the middle drawer.

probe +x: agentview shift was small; cabinet stays on the RIGHT so I treat +x as toward the BOTTOM and +y as toward the LEFT. Agentview: dark cabinet body is mid-right, wine rack above/behind it, open table in the center. Wrist: jaws open, cabinet still at the left edge, nothing between pads. Action: free-space step +x 0.08 and -y 0.10 at z=1.20 with gripper open, toward the cabinet front, above the bottle and bowl.

probe +x: treat +x as toward BOTTOM of agentview, +y toward LEFT. Cabinet is on the right; middle handle is a horizontal bar on the face toward table center. Wrist: jaws open, cabinet large on the left, nothing between pads. Action: free-space move toward the front of the middle drawer while rolling -20 and yawing -20 so the gripper will point at the handle with pads above and below it.

Agentview: gripper is in front of the dark cabinet on the right, above the table objects. Wrist: three horizontal silver handles are stacked on the cabinet face, left of the pads; middle bar is the target; close now would trap the handle: no. Action: roll -40, yaw -40, pitch back to 0, and step toward the middle handle (more +x, -y, down to z=1.05) so the opening meets the bar.

Agentview: gripper is angled down in front of the right-side cabinet; three handle bars visible on its face. Wrist: horizontal silver bars are above the pads, middle bar is the target, not between the jaws. close now would trap the handle: no. Action: continue roll to -60 and yaw to -60, pitch 0, shift to x=0.02 z=1.03 and back off slightly in +y so the swing clears the drawer face.

Agentview: gripper points toward the cabinet face on the right; handles are horizontal bars. Wrist: a silver handle sits just above the pads, not yet in the gap. close now would trap the handle: no. Action: roll -80 and yaw -80, pitch 0, nudge to x=0.03 z=1.02, hold y in front of the drawer so the fingers finish turning horizontal without hitting the face.

Agentview: gripper is nearly horizontal, pointing at the cabinet face on the right. Wrist: two horizontal silver handles are above the black pads, not in the gap. close now would trap the handle: no. Action: finish roll -90 and yaw -90 with pitch 0 so the jaws point straight at the drawer and open vertically around the middle bar.

Agentview: gripper is horizontal in front of the cabinet, jaws open. Wrist: two silver handles sit above the black pads; the gap between the pads is at the bottom of the frame and is empty. close now would trap the handle: no. Action: probe +z 3 cm, holding the horizontal grasp pose, to see if the middle bar moves down into the jaw gap.

probe +z: handles moved toward the TOP of the wrist, away from the pads at the bottom. Agentview: still in front of the cabinet, jaws open, not touching. Wrist: lower silver bar is still above the jaw gap. close now would trap the handle: no. Action: drop z to 1.00 so the middle bar moves down into the pad gap, hold the horizontal pose.

Agentview: open jaws are directly in front of the middle drawer handle on the right-side cabinet. Wrist: the lower silver bar moved toward the pads when z dropped; it is still just above the jaw gap. close now would trap the handle: no. Action: lower another 1.8 cm to z=0.988 so the middle bar sits in the gap between the pads.

Agentview: jaws face the middle drawer of the right cabinet. Wrist: the lower silver bar lines up with the gap between the pads, but it is still several centimeters in front of the fingertips. close now would trap the handle: no. Action: slide 5 cm toward the cabinet (-y) so the middle bar enters the jaws.

Agentview: open gripper is directly in front of the middle handle, very close to the cabinet face. Wrist: the lower silver bar is lined up in the jaw gap but the fingertips have not reached it yet. close now would trap the handle: no. Action: advance another 4 cm in -y to seat the middle bar between the pads.

Agentview: jaws are on the middle silver handle of the right cabinet. Wrist: the lower horizontal bar sits in the gap between the two pads. close now would trap the handle: yes. Action: close the gripper on the middle drawer handle.

Wrist: jaws shut below the silver bar; gripper_open is 0.05 so the close missed and the bar is above the pads. Agentview: still at the middle drawer of the right cabinet. close now would trap the handle: no. Action: reopen and raise 2 cm so the middle bar drops into the open gap.

Wrist: after raising, the silver bar moved farther above the pads; +z sends the bar toward the top of the wrist. gripper_open was 0.05 on the empty close. Agentview: still at the cabinet face. close now would trap the handle: no. Action: reopen fully, back off 2 cm, and lower to z=0.96 so the bar moves down into the jaw gap.

Wrist: one silver bar is lined up in the open jaw gap, gripper fully open. Agentview: gripper faces the cabinet on the right. close now would trap the handle: no, fingertips are still short of the bar. Action: drive in -y to y=-0.145 to put the bar between the pads.

Agentview: gripper is against the cabinet face on the right. Wrist: the silver bar is directly in front of the open pads at this height. close now would trap the handle: yes. Action: close on the bar and read gripper_open to see if the 1.6 cm handle is pinched.

Wrist: closed jaws are below the silver bar; gripper_open=0.05 so the pinch missed low. The bar center is about 4 cm above the pads. Agentview: still on the cabinet face. close now would trap the handle: no. Action: reopen and raise to z=1.012, easing 4 mm off the face, so the bar sits in the open gap.

Wrist: silver bar is still above the pads after the partial raise to z=0.997; gripper only 0.61 open. Agentview: gripper faces the cabinet. close now would trap the handle: no. Action: finish opening, rise to z=1.04, and move to y=-0.15 so the bar enters the vertical jaw gap.

note: Backed off the cabinet to y=-0.07 but z stayed stuck at 0.997 and the silver bar is still above the pads. Gripper is only half open. close now would trap the handle: no. Action: pure +z to 1.02 away from the face, finish opening, to test whether height was cabinet contact or an arm limit.

note: Wrist: handle is above the half-open pads and pure +z is blocked at 0.997 even off the face; gripper will not open past 0.50. Agentview: still in front of the cabinet. close now would trap the handle: no. Action: ease to y=-0.04, roll to -70, and lift to z=1.08 so the elbow can clear the bar.

note: Wrist: handle is still above the pads; fingers currently tip downward. z will not rise past 1.00 in this pose. Agentview: cabinet is to the right, gripper has backed away. close now would trap the handle: no. Action: return to horizontal roll -90 and step back in to y=-0.11 at z=0.99, under the bar.

Wrist: silver bar is just above the fully open pads, gripper_open=0.97. z cannot rise past 1.00 so the pads must reach up. Agentview: cabinet face is ahead. close now would trap the handle: no. Action: tilt fingers 20 deg up (roll -110) and drive to y=-0.16 to put the bar in the open span.

Wrist: silver bar is directly above and slightly in front of the open pads; fingers point up toward it. Agentview: gripper is at the cabinet face. close now would trap the handle: yes if the last 2 cm seats the bar. Action: drive to y=-0.175 and close on the middle handle.
